Initial release — AI-based system for detecting long-term immobility (over 12 hours) in solo-living elders using multi-zone fixed cameras.

- Continuously analyzes video from multiple home areas to detect human movement and activity.
- Sends "long-term no activity" alerts and notifies emergency contacts if no activity is detected within a configurable time window (default 12 hours).
- Designed for solo-living elder households and community elderly-care centers; integrates with smart-home security or care platforms.
- Includes strict requirements for user identification (open-id) before analysis or report queries.
- Enables structured, cross-zone inactivity reporting and easy access to past alert records via cloud API.
